run_binary_validation: run the BinaryFileValidator to validate binary file accessibility for a given AWS region
validate_local_binaries: validate the existence of local binaries by checking paths against the exe folder
validate_s3_binaries: validate the existence of S3 binaries by checking file existence via S3StorageService
format_validation_report: format a validation report with success or failure results and detailed error reasons
get_repo_path: get the binary repository path from the ONEDOCKER_REPOSITORY_PATH environment variable or default
